lanes.summary: The diff correctly implements the model capability ladder as requested in ticket PMAT-3477. It adds the required scripts to run the ladder tests and strictly checks receipts against defined rules. It establishes the Model Capability Ladder contract, registers the dogfood gate checker, and provides verified 0.68.1 receipts proving the fail cases. The tests cover the discrimination cases accurately. All requirements are met with no weakened gates or unrequested changes detected.

lanes.summary: Audit of PMAT-3477 (PR #3479, EPIC #3477) concludes with verdict PASS.
